text: Dongfeng Motor Corporation (东风汽车集团有限公司) is a Chinese central state-owned enterprise (央企): it appears as entry 30 in the central-enterprise (央企) directory published by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council (SASAC), and its own corporate profile describes it as a commercial first-class central SOE (商业一类央企) with its headquarters in Wuhan.
short: Dongfeng Motor Corporation is a Chinese central state-owned enterprise under SASAC.

source.name: SASAC (国务院国资委) - 央企名录 (central state-owned enterprises directory)
source.quote: 30 东风汽车集团有限公司

additionalSources.name: Dongfeng Motor Corporation - 企业介绍 (corporate introduction), dfmc.com.cn
additionalSources.quote: 东风汽车集团有限公司是以汽车制造、销售、服务和技术研发为主业的商业一类央企
